jobs.description:
At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. As the category leader in dermatology, we bring together science, innovation and people who are passionate about making a meaningful difference for patients around the world.
We are now looking for a QC Analyst to join our Quality Control team in Uppsala. This is a great opportunity for someone with a microbiology background who is looking to further develop their expertise within Quality Control in a highly regulated environment.
In this role, you will contribute to ensuring product quality, patient safety and compliance through microbiological testing, data review and collaboration with colleagues across the organization.
 
Your team
You will join a team of approximately 14 colleagues united by a strong commitment to quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. The team combines deep expertise with a collaborative mindset, creating an environment where knowledge is openly shared, challenges are solved together and everyone contributes to common goals.
There is a strong sense of teamwork, mutual respect and accountability within the group. Open communication, a willingness to support one another and a shared ambition to succeed create a positive working environment where people are encouraged to grow, contribute and perform at their best.
 
Your mission
As a QC Analyst, you will perform and review microbiological quality control activities in accordance with established methods, regulatory requirements and agreed timelines. You will support routine laboratory operations while contributing to the continuous improvement of processes, methods and ways of working.
Working closely with colleagues across Quality, Manufacturing and Technical Operations, you will help ensure that microbiological testing is performed accurately, efficiently and in compliance with applicable requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Perform microbiological analyses according to approved methods, SOPs and quality standards.
Review, evaluate and document analytical results in accordance with established procedures.
Support routine quality control activities within the microbiology laboratory.
Ensure laboratory documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.
Participate in investigations, deviation management and root cause analyses.
Support method validations, change controls and continuous improvement activities.
Review and update laboratory documentation and work instructions as required.
Ensure that laboratory equipment is maintained and used according to approved procedures.
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

 
Your profile
We are looking for someone with a background in microbiology and experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices or food production. You are structured, curious and eager to learn. You enjoy working in a laboratory environment, paying attention to details and following established procedures. You collaborate well with others, communicate clearly and take responsibility for delivering high-quality work.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, Biotechnology, Life Science or a related scientific discipline.
Experience working in a laboratory environment within a regulated industry.
Knowledge of GMP and quality requirements.
Experience with microbiological testing or related laboratory activities.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

 
Preferred Experience
Experience working within Quality Control.
Experience with environmental monitoring or environmental sampling.
Knowledge of microbiological laboratory techniques and quality systems.
Experience supporting investigations, deviations or change controls.

 
Location and information 
This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Odlings- och produktionsledare på The Culinary Farm
jobs.description:
Market Garden Production Manager 
Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden · March–November 2027 

We are looking for an experienced grower to take responsibility for the day-to-day production of The Culinary Farm starting in 2027.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys the pace, responsibility and problem-solving that comes with running a productive market garden.
About us 
Nominated as one of the Top 50 Farms in Europe, The Culinary Farm is a small-scale, diversified market garden in the heart of Skåne, southern Sweden
We grow a wide range of seasonal vegetables using agroecological principles, with a strong focus on flavour and quality. Our produce is grown primarily for chefs and our veggie-bag members in Malmö, Lund and Höör.
The farm also serves as an educational platform for Market Gardening in the Nordics.
Each season, we welcome 10–15 interns from around the world who join us for an immersive training in human-scale regenerative agriculture. 
The role 
As Market Garden Production Manager, you will be responsible for turning the seasonal crop plan into an efficient day-to-day operation, taking charge of all aspects of our production from seed to harvest.
You will: 
Plan weekly and daily production priorities.
Lead, organise and work alongside our interns.
Stay on top of sowing, planting, cultivation, irrigation and harvest.
Maintain high standards of quality and efficiency.
Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows.
Keep essential production and harvest records.
Ensure tools, irrigation systems, machinery and infrastructure are functioning properly.
How you work matters 
We are looking for someone who:
Is physically fit and enjoys working outside in all weather conditions Works efficiently and with purpose.
Is highly organised and strong at prioritising.
Sees both the immediate task and the bigger production picture. Takes initiative and solves problems independently.
Communicates clearly and leads by example.
Is self-motivated and also motivates others.
Creates structure, energy and a strong working pace within the team. Enjoys teaching and helping others develop their skills
Genuinely enjoys the intensity and variation of market gardening.
Experience 
You should have:
At least 1–2 full seasons of commercial vegetable-growing experience.
Experience with small-scale diversified vegetable production or Market Gardening. Knowledge of soil health, crop management and protection against pests & diseases. Experience leading, supervising or organising others.
Good communication skills in English.
A valid driving licence.
The legal right to work and live in Sweden.
Relevant horticultural or agricultural education is an advantage, but not required. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement.
What we offer 
The opportunity to lead in an established and ambitious market garden.
Work in an international team of young, passionate and driven change-makers
A role within our wider educational work around Market Gardening and human-scale food production in the Nordics.
A nice sun-kissed farmer’s tan
We work hard and maintain high standards, but we also want the farm to be a place where people enjoy working, learning and developing together.
Practical details
Position: Market Garden Production Manager
Location: Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden
E
mployment: 

Full-time seasonal position
Season: March–November 2027
Working hours: 08:00–17:00, including a one-hour lunch break Start: March 2027
Salary: To be negotiated based on experience

 Apply via our form: https://tmxggetk6he.typeform.com/to/tiflhp1H
 Applications are open to candidates across Europe.
Complete our online application form by October 15, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
Selected candidates will be invited for an interview, followed by a practical recruitment day on the farm for finalists.

We're looking for a Marketing Art Director to help shape how THE FINALS and ARC Raiders look everywhere outside the game: in campaigns, key art, trailers, merch, and partner work.
You'll sit in the Marketing team and work side by side with the Game Art Directors on both titles. Together you'll keep each game's identity consistent from in-game to out, and find ways to bring great marketing work back into the games. You'll set the visual direction, build the systems that let others execute it well, and stay hands-on when the work needs it.
Example of responsibilities 

Partner with game Art Directors to expand Embark’s 2D art production capabilities, unlocking new opportunities for marketing campaigns

Lead art direction across marketing campaigns, keeping the full asset suite consistent across key art, paid media, trailer slates and motion graphics in partnership with game Art Directors.

Build brand design systems that turn our games’ visual identities into scalable toolkits for campaigns and advertising.

Create and maintain style guides so agencies and partners can apply the brand correctly and consistently across digital, print, merch and licensing work.

Explore new visual territory for upcoming marketing opportunities through concept references, mockups and mood boards.

Present creative work with clear reasoning that ties visual choices to channel requirements, audience insights and expected impact.

Direct internal artists, agencies and freelancers, and give feedback that is kind, clear and actionable.

Who you are

A bridge between strategy and craft. You can shape the big-picture direction and then roll up your sleeves to make it real.

A systems thinker. You design for scale, so a single idea can carry from a trailer slate to a T-shirt without losing its identity.

Curious about what's next. You keep up with new tools, techniques and design principles to help us lead rather than follow trends.

A natural collaborator. You like partnering with game teams, respect their vision and look for chances to make in-game and out-of-game work stronger together.

A generous leader. You make the people and partners around you better through clear direction and thoughtful feedback.

Passionate about games, especially ours. You're excited to bring our worlds to life for our players and community.

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

Experience as an Art Director or Senior Designer in marketing or brand, ideally for games, entertainment or consumer brands.

A portfolio showing campaign work and brand systems you've led, from first concept to final execution across several channels.

Deep knowledge of the channels where marketing art lives (social, paid media, store pages, out-of-home, broadcast, print, merch, licensing) and what each one demands.

Proven experience building brand identities, design systems or style guides that other teams and partners have used at scale.

Experience directing external partners such as agencies and freelancers alongside internal artists.

Strong skills in typography, layout, colour and composition, plus solid knowledge of motion design principles.

Comfort with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects) or similar tools, and the ability to jump in hands-on.

Interest in emerging technologies, and experience integrating these into your workflows

Clear communication in English, written and spoken, including presenting to stakeholders.

 
At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise in industrial control systems, IT infrastructure, and cybersecurity, coupled with proven leadership and project management skills.

How you’ll make an impact
• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of engineers and specialists focused on IT and Cyber Security aspects of HVDC Control & Protection systems.
• Oversee the entire lifecycle of IT and Cyber Security solutions, from requirements gathering and architectural design to implementation, testing, and commissioning.
• Develop and implement strategies for secure and robust IT infrastructure within HVDC systems, adhering to industry standards and best practices (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST).
• Collaborate closely with HVDC Control & Protection engineers to integrate IT/Cyber Security solutions seamlessly into the overall system architecture.
• Stay abreast of emerging technologies, cybersecurity threats, and industry trends relevant to HVDC systems.
• Ensure compliance with all relevant company policies, industry regulations, and safety standards.

Your background
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cyber Security, or a related technical field.
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT or Cyber Security roles, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team management capacity.
• Good understanding of network architectures, operating systems (Windows, Linux), virtualization, and cloud technologies.

Experience in object-oriented C++ development for embedded systems.

Experience with real-time OS, multitasking, and inter-process communication.

Excellent English skills (spoken and written)

A customer-focused mindset and an interest in understanding how technology creates value for users.

A proactive approach to learning and professional development.

Develop software that contributes to products and solutions used in critical environments.

Work with experienced colleagues in an international R&D organization.

Contribute to the full software development lifecycle.

TL;DR:
Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's functionality while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies
Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend
Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.
Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)
Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints
Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build
Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus
You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats

What you’ll do
Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets
Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)
Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)
Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android

Our Tech Stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin
Frontend: React and Typescript
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase
Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery
DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane

And always on the lookout for what's next!
About your application
Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

We believe great companies are built by people who are driven to solve difficult problems.
At Nextory, we're building the future of reading and listening. It's an ambitious goal that demands exceptional execution, relentless curiosity, and a willingness to challenge convention. We set a high bar for ourselves because we believe that's what it takes to create products people love.
If you're motivated by impact, energized by ambitious teammates, and excited by the opportunity to build something category-defining, you'll feel at home here.
Let us tell you about the role 📖
This is an Account Manager role that combines opening new doors with creating relationships that last. You’ll be part of our Commercial Business Development team, where you’ll find and sign new valuable partners, while also developing the collaborations we already have across the Nordics. All with one main goal: bringing new listeners and readers to Nextory.
Your main responsibilities will include:

Identifying high-value prospects, reaching out and booking meetings

Negotiating and signing new partner agreements

Planning and launching the first campaign together with new partners

Continuously booking marketing activities with existing partners to drive conversions

Following up on results and finding new ways to improve each collaboration

Working closely with colleagues in Marketing, Product and Analytics to bring campaigns to life

Your story so far 👀
We believe you’re a relationship builder with a hunter’s instinct. You get energy from meeting new people and turning a good conversation into a signed deal, and you’re just as motivated by what comes after: making the collaboration & results grow. Most of all, you’re curious. You like trying new things, taking initiative, and experimenting, even when not everything works out, because around here, that’s how we learn.
Furthermore, we believe you have:

A degree in business administration, marketing, economics or similar

2-4 years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or B2B sales

A proven track record of finding new business and closing deals

Experience running campaigns & creating marketing materials together with partners or other external stakeholders

Fluency in Swedish and English, written and spoken

We’d be especially happy to see:

That you speak French

Experience from digital subscription services, streaming, media or consumer tech

A network in the Nordic market, for example within telecom, banking and loyalty programs, employee benefits or travel

That you’re comfortable working with data and analysis

That you already use AI tools in your everyday work, for example for prospecting, research or outreach

You don’t need to tick every box. If you love closing deals and have great instincts when it comes to growing partnerships, we want to talk to you.
The Nextory way of working 🏠
At Nextory, we believe a strong and inclusive culture is key to our success and that culture flourishes when we meet and collaborate in person as much as possible. That’s why we spend the majority of the working time at our beautiful office!
We are based in Stockholm, Sweden, with offices in Paris and Bangalore. Our hybrid work policy includes four days in the office and Wednesdays as a work-from-home day.
Your next story starts here 💫
We look forward to your application! Applications are reviewed continuously.
Please note that we do not offer relocation and that a six-month probationary period applies.

jobs.occupation: Technical Writer to a global company in Ludvika
jobs.description:
About our client
Our client, who is a global and world leading actor within their domain, strongly believe in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.
About the role
On behalf of our client, we are looking for an experienced Technical Writer to join their team in Ludvika.
In this role, you will be responsible for creating, structuring, and maintaining technical documentation for complex electrical systems and installations, covering everything from high- and low-voltage systems to control systems, HMI, and related equipment.
You will work closely with system engineers, technical specialists, and project teams to gather, analyze, and transform complex technical information into clear, accurate, and well-structured documentation. The role requires both technical understanding and strong communication skills, as you will play an important part in ensuring that technical information is accessible, consistent, and easy to understand across different engineering projects.
Key responsibilities
Create, structure, and maintain technical documentation for electrical installations, systems, and engineering solutions

Gather and interpret technical information in close collaboration with engineers and technical specialists

Produce user manuals, system descriptions, technical specifications, and other relevant documentation

Review, improve, and standardize existing technical documentation to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency

Plan and coordinate documentation activities across multiple engineering projects

Contribute to improving documentation processes, templates, and ways of working

Who are you?
We are looking for a structured and communicative person who enjoys combining technical understanding with clear and precise writing. You have a genuine interest in technology and the ability to understand complex technical systems and explain them in a way that is easy for others to understand.
To succeed in this role, you are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, manage your own priorities, and enjoy collaborating with engineers and technical specialists across different projects. You also take pride in delivering high-quality documentation and contributing to the development of effective ways of working.
We are looking for someone who has:
At least 5 years of experience in technical writing or technical documentation

A university degree, Bachelor’s or higher, in a relevant technical field

Experience documenting complex technical systems or engineering solutions

Good written and verbal communication skills in English

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience with electrical systems, power systems, HVDC technology, or industrial installations

Good communication skills in Swedish

Practical information
Location: Ludvika, Sweden
Scope: Full-time
Start date: As agreed
Employment type: In this recruitment process, you will initially be employed as a consultant by A-hub and work on assignment at our client. After 12 months, the ambition is for you to transition into direct employment with the client.

We look forward to receiving your application!
A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

The Opportunity
At Hitachi Energy Components in Ludvika, we are continuing to grow and develop our business. As more employees join our organization and new competencies are required, ensuring a structured and effective approach to onboarding, training, and competency development has become increasingly important.
We are now looking for a Training & Development Specialist who will take ownership of our internal training structure and learning processes. This is a newly established role with significant opportunity to influence how onboarding, training, and competency development are managed across our organization.
We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, coordinating initiatives, and working with a broad range of stakeholders. You bring experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or other technical environment and are comfortable collaborating with technical experts and operational teams.

How you’ll make an impact
Coordinate onboarding and support the continuous improvement of the new employee experience.
Develop and maintain internal training processes and competency development structures.
Coordinate training programs and collaborate with stakeholders across Sweden and globally to ensure relevant and up-to-date training content.
Create and maintain training materials, presentations, guides, and learning resources.
Support subject matter experts in developing structured and effective training programs.
Manage learning systems, training documentation, records, and competency data.
Track training KPIs, identify improvement opportunities, and support continuous development of learning initiatives.

Your Background
Experience in a coordination-focused role such as project coordination, HR, administration, executive support, competency management, or similar.
Experience from an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or engineering environment, with the ability to understand technical roles, processes, and competency requirements.
Experience supporting, delivering, or coordinating training and development initiatives is highly regarded.
Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the confidence to engage and present across different functions and organizational levels.

Professional communication skills in both Swedish and English.

ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
Would you like to become part of a growing company that offers good opportunities for professional development while contributing to the sustainable maintenance and protection of our customers’ homes?
Then send your application today!
Candidate selection takes place on an ongoing basis.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.
Roof cleaning can involve unexpected challenges related to the surface, dimensions, and similar issues. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, is not afraid to take initiative, and can suggest creative solutions.
Naturally, we also want you to be flexible, learn quickly, and contribute to creating a good atmosphere within your team, as well as during any contact with customers.
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
• Good knowledge of English.
• B or BE driving licence.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.

• A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.
• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.
• Accommodation provided for the duration of your employment with us. Team members share the same apartment/accommodation.
• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.
• Hourly-paid employment.
• Salary is paid on the 25th of each month and covers the work performed during the previous month.
Working in different areas of Sweden is not only a professional opportunity, but also a way to experience the country, visit different places, and gain new experiences.
If you are hardworking, responsible, cooperative, and eager to develop your skills within a growing company, we would be happy to receive your application!

jobs.occupation: Sous Chef till Mr.Bronck på Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description:
Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability. 
 
The hotel has just completed a full renovation and we are now looking for a new member to join our a la carte kitchen team in the position of Sous Chef within our newly open New York brasserie restaurant Mr. Bronck.
Read more about it on https://mrbronck.com/
Apart from the restaurant, the a la carte kitchen serves also food to our cocktail bar Sally's and room service.
 
As Sous Chef, you will be responsible for the planning, preparation, and ensuring exceptional food quality, presentation, and timely service. You will lead and manage the kitchen team during service, uphold the highest hygiene standards, and maintain effective cost control.
 
Main responsibilities:

●       Manage the daily operation of our kitchen and stewarding teams, actively participating in service. 
●       Help the head chef to develop menus as required seasonally to fit our different concepts and needs.
●       Supervise the production of quality food products in the restaurant ensuring high standards are always kept
●       Develop a strategy plan for the minimization of food wastage
●       To assure the development and coaching/training all kitchen team members
●       To oversee the daily ordering of the necessary food products
●       To overview the HACCP control of our operation ensuring we are adhering to the set regulations
●       Act on kitchen related guest requests and problems in a manner that follows the hotels vision and policies 
●       Build and maintain a strong relationship with the service team
 
Qualifications:
You are a creative team player who thrives in a high-pace kitchen operation making exceptionally high-quality food.
 
●       You have at least 3-year experience working in similar position in a high-level restaurant or hotel kitchen.
●       Creative personality who enjoys developing concepts and thinking outside the box.
●       Experienced in developing high level menus.
●       Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and manage a team.
●       Ambitious and interested in working in a high-pace environment with great standards.
●       Out-going personality who has an easy way communicating with colleagues and guests.
●       Good sense of service and a genuine desire to exceed guests' and employees' expectations.
●       You enjoy structure and have good organizational skills.
●       High professional ethics.
●       Luxury hospitality is your passion, and you have a genuine love for food.
